Situation Report — Day 27

  • Attacks & Strikes
    • IDF completed an additional wave of strikes targeting Iranian infrastructure across Tehran (today).
    • IRGC claims Iranian forces struck a US military support vessel off Salalah, Oman.
    • Drones struck the Port of Salalah: one crane damaged, one foreign worker injured. Damage limited so far.
  • Northern Border
    • Hezbollah struck an IDF armored vehicle in Tyre with a fiber‑optic FPV drone, possibly armed with a PG‑7 pattern anti‑tank warhead — notable employment of that drone profile in Tyre.
    • Two Israeli soldiers seriously wounded in Lebanon clashes. Separate reports: two Lebanese soldiers killed after an IDF strike on Deir Zahrani.
  • Shipping & Hormuz
    • Iran continues selective Gulf access: allowing passage for Russia, India, China while blocking others. Salalah attack raises risk to regional ports and logistics.
  • Diplomacy & Pauses
    • US announced a second 10‑day pause on Iran energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 20:00 ET), citing an Iranian request and “talks going very well.” Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan is mediating.
    • Precedent: the prior 5‑day pause was violated hours later by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Casualties & Damage
    • Salalah: one injured, one crane damaged. No port closure reported.
    • Lebanon: two Lebanese soldiers killed; two Israeli soldiers seriously wounded.
  • 🟢 Good News Damage at Salalah appears limited; no confirmed wider shipping disruptions yet.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating — strikes inside Iran continue and cross‑border attacks persist.

Current Snapshot — Day 27

  • Active strikes: IAF/US waves hit multiple Iranian sites today; drone strikes hit Gulf facilities (Salalah, Kuwait airport). Northern Israel under daily Hezbollah fire.

Immediate Attacks & Strikes

  • IAF: 50+ jets struck Iranian regime infrastructure across three areas; IDF announced additional strikes on Tehran targets.
  • Iranian claims: strike on US refuelling aircraft at Prince Sultan Air Base (US reports dozens of US troops wounded across recent strikes).
  • Two drones struck Port of Salalah (Oman). Crane damaged; one foreign worker injured. IRGC says it targeted a US military support vessel near Salalah.
  • Kuwait Int’l Airport hit by multiple drones; Kuwaiti authority reports radar destroyed.

Northern Border (Hezbollah)

  • Daily clashes. Hezbollah struck an IDF armored vehicle in Tyre using a fiber‑optic FPV drone armed with a PG‑7 pattern warhead.
  • Clashes in Al‑Bayada; at least two Lebanese soldiers killed after Israeli strike on Deir Zahrani. Israeli troops sustained casualties in north.

Regional—Gulf & Saudi Theater

  • Iran allowing passage through Hormuz for select states (Russia, India, China); blocking others.
  • Yemeni Houthis say they launched an attack on Israel — first confirmation in this phase.

Diplomacy & Pauses

  • Trump announced a SECOND pause on Iranian energy strikes: 10 days (deadline Apr 6, 2026, 8 PM ET), citing an Iranian request. Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating multilateral talks.

Evacuations & Civilians

  • ~330 Russian nationals evacuated from Iran via Armenia.
  • West Bank: 3 Palestinians killed in separate West Bank incidents.

Tactical Notes

  • Notable use of fiber‑optic FPV anti‑armor drone by Hezbollah. Continued targeting of air refuellers signals focus on degrading coalition sustainment.
  • 🟢 Good News: ~330 Russian nationals evacuated; Pakistan hosting regional talks.

Threat assessment

  • Escalating.

תקיפות מיידיות

  • חיל‑האוויר: יותר מ‑50 מטוסים תקפו תשתיות משטר האיראני בשלוש אזורים; צה"ל דיווח על גל תקיפות נוסף על טהרן.

  • נמל כווית הותקף בידי מספר רחפנים; רדאר הוצא מהשירות לפי הרשויות הכווייתיות.

פינוי ואוכלוסייה

  • היו הרוגים פלסטינים בגדה המערבית באירועים נפרדים.

  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: כ‑330 פונו; פקיסטן מארחת שיחות אזוריות.

הערכת איום

  • בעירה.

Kuwait International Airport radar destroyed by an Iranian drone attack; multiple drone strikes reported at Kuwait Airport.

  • 🟢 Good News: Temporary US pause on energy strikes announced; Pakistan hosting mediation; ~330 civilians evacuated from Iran.

Situation Report — Day 27

Active strikes: US/Israeli airstrikes across Iran; Iranian, Hezbollah and allied drone/rocket strikes on Israel; daily clashes on the northern border.

  • Air & Strike Campaign

    • IDF: 50+ IAF jets struck multiple Iranian regime sites across three areas.
    • US/Israel continue precision strikes in Tehran region and other Iranian sites.
    • Reports claim Iranian strike at Prince Sultan AB damaged/destroyed US KC-135 tankers; Iran and some outlets claim one destroyed, three damaged. US reports dozens of wounded soldiers this week (15 at Prince Sultan reported seriously/less serious).

  • Northern Border (Hezbollah)

    • Daily Hezbollah attacks. Tyre: Hezbollah struck an IDF armored vehicle with a fiber-optic FPV drone, possibly armed with PG-7 pattern warhead.
    • Clashes in Al-Bayada. Two Lebanese soldiers killed after Israeli strike on Deir Zahrani.

  • Gulf & Maritime

    • Iran allowed Strait of Hormuz transit for Russia, India, China; others restricted.
    • Oman: Two drones struck Port of Salalah — damaged a crane, one foreign worker injured. IRGC says they targeted a US support vessel offshore.
    • Kuwait Intl Airport radar destroyed by an Iranian strike.
    • Houthis confirmed they launched an attack on Israel — first time in this campaign.

  • Diplomacy & Pauses

    • Trump announced a second pause on US strikes against Iranian energy infrastructure for 10 days (deadline Apr 6, 2026, 8 PM ET), citing an Iranian request; Iran denies direct talks. First 5-day pause (Mar 23) was violated by strikes hours later.
    • Pakistan to host mediation talks with Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Egypt on the Iran war.

  • Other

    • Some 330 Russian nationals evacuated from Iran via Armenia.
    • Flight restrictions remain: airports in Iran, Iraq, Syria closed.

  • 🟢 Good News

    • 330+ Russian nationals successfully evacuated via Armenia.
    • Pakistan agreed to host multilateral talks — diplomatic window opened.
    • Temporary 10-day US pause on energy strikes announced (potential de-escalation window).

  • Bottom line

    • Threat assessment: Escalating — high tempo airstrikes, cross-border attacks and wider Gulf involvement.
